claims.claim: The full odd continuous retarded response to the finite packet quadratic source has integrated local phase square O_S(1) through S R^2.
The homogeneous initial correction has an all-time local-energy bound from its unweighted energy; no shape decay is claimed.
A packet-driven linear solver checks time, space and domain sensitivity and energy/source-work balance; it is not the full nonlinear RP evolution.
Even feedback and matching to the actual generated continuum remain open, as do cubic trace and modal action errors.
